verification.source_review: Reviewed Google URL constants/query encoding, serialized Firefox policies and exact-match DuckDuckGo home migration using atomic store persistence. Profile IDs, timestamps, proxy secrets, bookmarks and custom URLs are preserved. No new IPC, shell/SQL/template sink or authorization changes.
verification.review_fixes: No blocking findings in this patch. Existing trust boundaries unchanged.
verification.secret_scan: Staged source scan excludes unrelated landing directory, real userData, backups, engine cache, credentials and generated build outputs. Tests use synthetic account metadata.
verification.instructions_review: New plans and documentation describe authorized implementation and contain no instructions to exfiltrate secrets or override runtime trust boundaries.
verification.dependencies: No dependency changes, package version only. npm audit --omit=dev reports zero vulnerabilities.
verification.release_manifest: Version2.2.1, installer byte size and SHA512 match latest.yml; SHA256SUMS generated for installer, blockmap and manifest.
verification.tests: 35 unit and29 packaged manager/Chromium scenarios passed. Native regression verifies Google in saved Firefox search settings, bookmarks, identity and account storage; authenticated SOCKS5 regression passed.

limitations: Source review and dependency audit do not prove absence of vulnerabilities. Windows runtime/unsigned release/upstream engine are trusted. Abrupt browser/OS loss may lose changes since the last native snapshot. Real provider-account acceptance and a separate clean machine were not tested.
